articleTitle: Voltage Stability of Received Power Grids with UHVDC Systems Under Different Initial States of Synchronous Condensers
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: This paper studies the influence of synchronous condensers under different initial reactive power states on system transient voltage stability in received power grids with ultra-high voltage direct current (UHVDC) systems. It is helpful for the synchronous condensers incorporating the system static voltage regulation. The voltage stability problem of an actual received power grid with an UHVDC system is introduced. And then, the voltage stability under different initial reactive power states of synchronous condensers and grid voltage control strategies are presented. The scenarios that the synchronous condensers can take part in the system static voltage regulation are summarized. At last, the static voltage regulation model of synchronous condensers is established with an objective function and sets of constraints. By using the actual power grid of UHVDC System, it is verified that the synchronous condenser can participate in the static voltage regulation in this scenarios, and the transient voltage stability of the system will not get worse.

articleTitle: Development of the Monitoring System in the Smart Distribution Substation in Guangzhou, China
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Guangzhou Power Supply Bureau Co. Ltd. used status detection and environment perception technology for smart transformation of the distribution substations. Until 2019, 1157 distribution substations have been upgraded for smart transformation and put into service. This paper introduced the four major modules of the upgraded smart distribution substation monitoring system and, consequently, the development of the smart distribution substation inspection and control system will be described. Operation and maintenance cost was reduced, man power was saved and the management level of the distribution substations was improved. Based on that, a full coverage of another ca. 40,000 distribution substations is planned for the smart transformation by 2027, as part of the smart grid transformation.

articleTitle: Frequency Offset Estimation of Chirp Modulation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Chirp spread spectrum technology has attracted much attention because it has low complexity, low power consumption, good anti-multipath and anti-interference ability, which can be used in smart grid communication system. This paper describes the mathematical model of chirp modulation and demodulation, analyzes the influence of frequency offset on the performance of chirp demodulation under different spreading factors (SF), then we propose and analyze a frequency offset estimation algorithm based on Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) and the relationship between the SF of preamble symbols and the SF of data symbols when the demodulation performance loss is relatively small. Finally, simulation results show that compensation based on the estimated frequency offset can improve the demodulation performance and coverage distance of chirp modulation.

articleTitle: Remote Inspection Technology of Transformer Substation Based on Sensing Technology and Linkage Control
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: This paper was based on the project of "Research on remote inspection technology of transformer substation based on sensing technology and linkage control". It researches on intelligent inspection and intelligent security. There are still many places that cannot meet the demand of power operation and maintenance in the practical application process by analysing the current development status of the remote inspection of smart substation. The operation and maintenance requirements of intelligent substation are improved by means of optimizing operation and maintenance strategy, data intelligent early warning technology and verification technology of remote fault warning by the sensing technology and the linkage control .Then it can realize the "one-key patrol inspection" in the distance of the substation. The sensing technology and the linkage control can make intelligent substation of safety in production control to improve the efficiency and quality of transformer substation operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: HHT for Vibration Signal Analysis in Tower Bolt Looseness Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In the detection of tower bolt looseness by vibration wave, how to judge and identify whether tower bolt looseness occurs through vibration signal is one of the research focuses. Hilbert-Huang transform (HHT) is applied to the processing and analysis of vibration signals in detection. Taking the real transmission tower as the experimental object, the experimental site is arranged, the experimental scheme is designed, and the vibration signal of the tower after excitation is collected by using the vibration detection device. HHT transformation is carried out on the vibration signals of the iron tower bolts under fastening and loosening conditions respectively. Through the analysis of experimental results, it can be seen that the method can realize the identification and judgment of the iron tower bolts loosening. Compared with the spectrum after Fourier transform, it is proved that the spectrum after HHT transform can more intuitively identify the bolt looseness state, and is more suitable for tower bolt looseness detection based on vibration wave, providing reference for further research.

articleTitle: Short Term Load Forecasting Based on Bayesian Forecasting Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Short term load forecasting plays an increasingly important role in Smart Grid. Short term load forecasting is also an important part of enterprise power system management. Providing accurate load time series data for a certain period of time in the future can enable enterprises to ensure the smooth operation of production while making a reasonable power plan, reducing power consumption and basic electricity charges, thus reducing the production cost of enterprises. In addition, lower electricity consumption means lower carbon dioxide emissions, which has far-reaching implications for sustainable development strategies. This paper presents a short-term load forecasting method based on time series. The model divides the time series data into four parts: trend item, period item, holiday item and error item. In the experiment part, this paper provides a set of preprocessing method flow. Aiming at the problem that the sampling rate of the current smart grid data is not constant, a data smoothing algorithm is proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Tunnel Wireless Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In view of the shortcomings of the existing tunnel communication technology, based on the principle of wireless sensor network (WSN), the important research achievements in the field of tunnel wireless communication in recent years are summarized in terms of topology structure, module design and tunnel application of Zigbee technology. On the basis of the above review, the future research direction of tunnel wireless communication technology is prospected, which provides reference for the development of tunnel wireless communication technology.

articleTitle: Study on LED Visible Light Communication Channel Model Based on Poisson Stochastic Network Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Visible light communication is a wireless communication using visible light as the transmission medium, using the existing light-emitting diode as the light source, and achieve high-speed communication at the same time. In this paper, with the help of Poisson stochastic network theory theory, a visible light communication channel model is established, including the transmission model, light source model and impact response calculation method, and the mean value of the visible light channel SINR and the approximate expression of the probability distribution are derived. And then, based on the visible light channel model, this paper explores the indoor LED light layout method, and verifies the method by simulating the indoor optical power distribution under different LED lamp layouts. Simulation results show that, in the actual indoor visible light communication, the scheme proposed in this paper can be used to obtain the optimal layout of LED lamp in visible light communication system.

articleTitle: Research on Image Encryption in Secure Communication System of Space Laser Chaos Keying
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In this paper, short reference code index differential chaotic shift keying can enhance the security performance of the system in the space laser communication system. Through the transmission of picture information, the confidentiality of the system is analyzed. The pixel correlation analysis, statistical histogram, and plaintext sensitivity prove that the system has high security performance.

Author Keywords: Short Reference Code Index Modulation Differential Chaotic Shift Keying (SRCIM-DCSK)

articleTitle: The Feasibility Analysis of Constructing a Regional University Library Resource Sharing Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: This article discusses the feasibility of establishing a regional library resource sharing platform by categorizing and investigating the literature resources of various universities in Wuhan. The results indicate that the resources of college libraries at different levels are unevenly distributed, especially the resources of college libraries are obviously insufficient; the resources of the peer college libraries have their own advantages. Constructing a regional university library resource sharing platform can compensate for the shortage of resources in some college libraries, complement each other's library resources, increase the utilization rate of library resources in colleges and universities, and serve the teaching and scientific research.

articleTitle: Research on Escape Velocity of People At High Altitude
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In the environment of low oxygen and low pressure at high altitude, each physiological system in human body will be greatly affected, thus affecting the escape speed of personnel from various aspects. In this paper, the indexes of human body function in high altitude environment have been investigated, and the maximal oxygen uptake has been identified as the main factor affecting the human body's movement function, and the escape velocity of people in high altitude environment has been determined by theoretical derivation. The results show that: as the oxygen uptake of human body gradually decreases with the increase of altitude, the escape velocity of personnel decreases with the increase of altitude, and there is an obvious relationship with gender and age. In conclusion, the evaluation expression of escape velocity of different people at different altitudes has been put forward. The determination of escape velocity at different altitudes provides theoretical basis for the rationality and safety of escape structure design of high-altitude engineering personnel, and is of great significance for disaster prevention and rescue design of high-altitude engineering and safety assurance of personnel evacuation.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Topology Control in Mobile Predictive Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Mobile Ad Hoc network is composed of a group of nodes equipped with wireless communication devices and networking capabilities, which does not need any infrastructure. Compared with the traditional wireless network, the mobile Ad Hoc network is a self constructed, self-organized and self managed network without any centralized infrastructure. The reliability of mobile Ad Hoc network can be improved from the aspects of transmission control, routing protocol, topology control, etc. in this paper, an Ad Hoc network topology control model is proposed. Considering the main objectives of topology control, an Ad Hoc network is designed according to the related network model. the related factors of topology control are synthetically measured, and a key algorithm of topology control is designed by using OPNET The network modeling and simulation tools verify the reliability of the algorithm, reduce the energy consumption of the network, have better end-to-end transmission performance, and effectively enhance the reliability of mobile Ad Hoc network. It improves the ability of mobile prediction and guarantees the connectivity and service quality of the network.

articleTitle: File Encryption System Based on the Hybrid LPC Coefficient and AES Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: At present, academic research on information security is getting deeper and wider. In this paper, the LPC coefficient and the speech waveform characteristics are mixed to form the hybrid LPC coefficient. The hybrid LPC is then used as the secret key of the AES algorithm in the file encryption system. The system is designed based on VS2012, all the files can be encrypted and decrypted by the system using the voice hybrid LPC key, and the system performance is relatively stable.

articleTitle: Life Cycle Management System of Intelligent Distribution Room Condition Monitoring Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of the life cycle management of the state monitoring equipment in the intelligent power distribution room, the life cycle management is divided into three parts: early management, mid-term management and late management. The characteristics, management strategies and precautions of equipment management in the three periods are introduced. The method of purchasing equipment with full life cycle cost, the calculation formula and evaluation method of purchase cost, operation cost, maintenance cost, failure cost and scrap cost are given. This paper puts forward a classification deduction system for faults in operation and maintenance period of state monitoring equipment, classifies and deducts points for equipment faults according to fault types and equipment deterioration degree, and gives general evaluation formulas for different equipment. Taking Guangzhou Power Supply Bureau as an example, using the method of full life cycle cost and fault classification deduction, the equipment cost can be obtained more intuitively and the equipment evaluation can be carried out more quickly through the model.

articleTitle: Multi-Dimensional Efficiency and Benefit Evaluation System of Operation Effect of Power Grid Project Cluster and Corresponding Application Prospect
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: China's economy has entered a new normal, the growth rate of electricity has slowed, the reform of transmission and distribution prices has continued to deepen, and the operating pressure has continued to increase. In order to improve investment efficiency, it is urgent to implement scientific, stable and precise investment from the source, formulate a reasonable investment strategy, quantify the comprehensive benefits of multi-service integration, and achieve coordinated development with economy, society and energy. In this study, based on the relevant data of power grid projects, the index evaluation system of power grid project is established, and the efficiency and benefit valuation of operation effect of the project is carried out according to the two dimensions of the time length of operation and the function type, including guarantee of power supply, power supply of electric railway, strengthening of transmission channel, meeting power demand and optimization of grid structure. Then, the operation effect of the project cluster is analyzed and evaluated, which provides important support for the efficiency and benefit management of similar projects in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Data-Driven Two-Sided Matching between Doctors and Patients
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Objective: Based on the theory of two-sided matching, using data-driven statistical methods to provide methodology for two-sided matching of doctors and patients. Methods: Firstly, Calculate characteristic statistics of doctors and patients based on HIS system data, and the difference characteristics of patients contacted by different doctors were identified as the evaluation index of matching satisfaction. Then, Fisher discriminant is used to calculate the weight of matching satisfaction index.Construct two-sided matching function with discriminant function.According to the paste progress of matching function value, the two-sided matching between doctors and patients is realized. Results: Using 13748 HIS data of two doctors in thoracic medicine department of a large hospital, 22 matching satisfaction evaluation indexes were extracted by the matching method given in this study. And a matching test was carried out with the actual patient data, which proved the validity of the matching results of this method. Conclusion: The matching method presented in this study can realize the process of doctor-patient matching from patients' characteristics to doctors' labels, from doctors' labels to patients' matching and sticking progress, and provide methodology for data-driven doctor-patient two-sided matching. The research of this paper is one to many matching, and the matching satisfaction index is limited. In the future, we can further expand the research perspective and carry out the research of intelligent matching system for doctors and patients on Internet platform.

Author Keywords: two-sided matching of doctors and patients

articleTitle: Research on Space Laser Hybrid Chaotic Shift Keying Secure Communication System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Using the principle of SR-DCSK scheme and applying code index modulation to information bearing signal, this paper presents a differential shift keying scheme with Short Reference Code Index, and applies it to space laser communication system, improving the security performance of space laser communication system.

Author Keywords: short reference differential chaos shift keying
Short Reference Code Index Modulation Differential Chaotic Shift Keying

articleTitle: Research on Emergency Response Processing Model of Thermal Power Enterprise Based on Epidemic Situation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: As the population grows and the demand for social productivity increases, humanity's demand for energy is increasing day by day, and the emergency management of thermal power generation companies during the epidemic has become a significant research content to ensure the safety of social power supply and people's lives as well as property. Therefore, taking the power plant responding to the epidemic as an example for example analysis, the index system and evaluation model constructed in the previous chapter are adopted in the paper to conduct an emergency capability assessment during epidemic of the power plant with the assistance of relevant experts. Through analyzing and explaining the evaluation results, it is proved that the result is in line with reality.

articleTitle: Variation of Satellite Timing Group Delay in Beidou Regional Satellite Navigation System in 2019
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: As a significant part of GNSS navigation message, timing group delay is one of the main errors in GNSS applications such as navigation, positioning, timing and ionospheric estimation. DCB solution in One-TGD-fixed constraint condition is more suitable for Beidou regional satellite navigation system, in which the TGD parameter exit calibration value of a certain GEO satellite is fixed as the constraint condition. Based on the global ionospheric map provided by IGS as a reference, monthly TGD parameters in 2019 have been calculated to analyse the characteristics of satellite TGD changes. The results demonstrate that the stability of TGD parameters is from high to low in the order of GEO satellites, MEO satellites and IGSO satellites. The changes of all satellites in a year are within 1ns, and most of them are within 0.5 ns. Monthly changes in TGD-B1B2 are in -1.6 ~ 1.5ns, and TGD-B1B3 are in -1.4 ~ 1.2ns. TGD-B1B3 parameters are more stable than TGD-B1B2 parameters in monthly variation, with maximum changes in a month within 1.6ns for TGD-B1B2 and 1.3ns for TGD-B1B3, average changes in a month within 0.7ns for TGD-B1B2 and 0.5ns for TGD-B1B3.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Ability of New Ship Maintenance Based on Super Decision Software
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In order to overcome the inevitable compatibility problems between the indicators in the index system, this paper uses Analytic Network Process (ANP) to deal with the tendency opinions of experts, and calculates the index weight of the evaluation system with the help of Super Decision software. From the calculation results, the index weight conforms to the expert tendency and the army evaluation practice, and the Analytic Network Process (ANP) and Super Decision software are worth popularizing.

Author Keywords: Evaluating the Ability of New Ship Maintenance

articleTitle: Research and Design of Online Monitoring Device for Temperature Rise of Cable Joints of Ring Network Cabinet
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Due to the influence of the installation process and the use environment, the cable joints of the ring network cabinet often have a vicious accident of burning the cable joints. In order to find out the fault information of the cable joint as early as possible and avoid the occurrence of the burning fault, an online monitoring device for the temperature rise of the cable joint is designed, the device compares the temperature of the three-phase cable joint with the ambient temperature by monitoring, it can overcome the influence of ambient temperature on the temperature rise monitoring of cable joints, at the same time, the radio frequency technology is used to transmit the temperature information of the cable joint, which solves the physical isolation problem of high and low voltage. Using narrow-section CT, based on the saturation technology, the high current is limited, and the power supply problem of the temperature measurement sensor is solved. The online monitoring device based on embedded technology has been applied and tested on site to meet the requirements of the online monitoring of the temperature rise of the cable joint of the ring network cabinet, it has important significance for power supply safety.

articleTitle: The Effectiveness Analysis of the Supervision from Government on Control the Quality Behavior Risks of Enterprises in the Construction Industry
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The quality behavior risks aroused by the opportunistic behavior of enterprises have a significant impact on the overall quality of construction industry projects. This also presents a challenge for quality supervision from the government. The dynamic evolution of the selection of strategy between government supervisors and enterprises is studied in this paper. The evolutionary game model between government supervisors and enterprises is constructed. Based on system dynamics theory, the evolutionary process on the supervision from the government to control the quality behavior risks is then simulated. The reasons for deviation of quality behavior aroused by enterprises are explained by the prospect theory. The results show that there is no stable point in the risk control system of the quality behavior. Since the fluctuations happen during the evolutionary game process, the system finally evolves to the strategy of government adopting negative supervision and participants not adopting opportunistic behavior under any initial strategies of non-equilibrium. It proves that the government adopting negative supervision has a strikingly positive influence on controlling the quality behavior risks of enterprises. The outcomes of this study provide theoretical support for the transitional government to innovate the mode of supervision.

articleTitle: MTRC Compensation for Sparse Aperture ISAR Imaging
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the improvement of the resolution of radar system, the migration through resolution cells (MTRC) in inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) imaging becomes more and more serious. It can be well compensated for the complete data. For the sparse aperture (SA) data, however, the compensation of MTRC is still a challenge. In this paper, a novel MTRC compensation algorithm for sparse aperture ISAR (SA-ISAR) imaging is proposed. Specifically, the MTRC compensation for SA-ISAR imaging is modeled as a sparse signal recovery problem, in which the sparse signal is modeled by the Laplacian scale mixture (LSM) prior and reconstructed by the expectation maximization based variational Bayesian inference (EM-VB) algorithm. Experimental results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Study of an Access Protocol for Satellite Network with Open TDMA
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The communication architecture of multi-constellation network is investigated, and an inter-satellite network access protocol based on open time division multiple access is proposed. The protocol can realize the smooth access of different constellation nodes to channels through the communication interaction frames, and achieve the interconnection among different constellations. Moreover it can provide various priority QoS guarantees for the nodes in constellations. Then the simulation results verify the rationality of the data transmission architecture and the validity of the protocol, which provides a way for network communication in the large-scale multi-constellations.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis on the Specialty of Relay Protection and Automation Technology in Power System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Under the background of industry education integration, the purpose of this study is to understand the demand of power system relay protection and automation technology professionals, and to provide suggestions for personnel training. Questionnaire survey is carried out for graduates and employers of power system relay protection and automation technology, so as to accurately locate the major according to market demand and provide comprehensive and objective basis for teaching standards of the major.

articleTitle: Design of Soft-Switching Inverter Power Supply Based on PWM in the Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In view of the development trend of modern power electronic technology towards miniaturization and high frequency, the high frequency switch brings the switching loss state of devices. This research proposes a load commutation soft-switching inverter based on IR2104. The load of the transformer uses appropriate resonant components to realize automatic inverter switching of the inverter power supply to turn off the IGBT, which reduces the turn-on and turn-off losses. Simultaneously, the chip is utilized to understand the chip of the driving circuit and lessen the size of the inverter. Under the operational status of the circuit via simulation software, the driving signals and the working state of the soft-switching tube in the circuit are simulated and analysed. The experimental results verify that the self-turning-off of the switching tube is achieved under the high-frequency soft-switching working condition. On-off loss is reduced.

articleTitle: Standard Power Meter Verification Strategy Optimization Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the existing standard power meter verification process and result judgment are overly dependent on the operation of the personnel, a verification strategy optimization method based on knowledge graph is proposed and applied to the standard power meter verification process. A semi-automatic approach is taken to construct the knowledge graph, and it is used for knowledge reasoning of verification process. Experimental results show that the proposed method has high accuracy and can improve the verification efficiency by about 20%.

articleTitle: Can Positive Emotion Benefit to Leader-Member Exchange? The Role of Leader Identification
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Although leader-member exchange (LMX) has received burgeoning attention in recent decades, a majority of research focus on how leaders rather than followers affect LMX. Zooming in the effect of followers' emotions on LMX, this study proposes that followers' positive emotions and leader identification is associated with LMX, further hypothesizes that leaders' positive emotions moderate the relationship between leader identification and LMX. Results from 319 Chinese employees show that followers' positive emotions and leader identification are positively related to LMX. Moreover, leaders' positive emotions moderatethe relationship between leader identification and LMX.

articleTitle: Global Supply Chain Restructuring Trends and Countermeasures Under the New Coronary Pneumonia Outbreak
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The New Coronary Pneumonia epidemic situation has a major impact on the world economic order. The security of global supply chains has encountered unprecedented challenges. The reconstruction of supply chains in many fields will be inevitable. Maintaining the security of the global supply chain is the foundation and guarantee for the steady development of the world economy. The impact of the epidemic situation on the global supply chain will prompt some countries and enterprises to rethink the supply chain layout and security. The epidemic situation will also accelerate the intelligent upgrade of the global supply chain, and the global supply chain center will accelerate the transfer to the emerging economies such as China, India, some core industries related to national security will return to the country under the government's request. Countries should strengthen cooperation, give play to their comparative advantages, promote global supply chain security governance, and maintain global free trade rules and global supply chain security.

Author Keywords: the new coronary pneumonia epidemic situation

articleTitle: Research and Application of Image Registration Based on Singular Value Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Image registration has a wide range of applications in pattern recognition, medical image analysis, image mosaic and other image processing, which is a very important technology in the field of image processing. Aiming at the shortcomings of traditional image registration algorithms in terms of matching accuracy and speed, a fast image registration algorithm based on singular value decomposition (SVD) is proposed by combining point set matching with variable template hierarchical search. Experimental results show that the improved algorithm has obvious advantages in image registration speed compared with the traditional algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Double-Channels Frequency Adjustment System for Passive Underground Detection Based on Frame Header Feedback
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: A double-channels frequency adjustment system for passive underground pipeline detection based on frame header feedback is introduced to realize the information interaction between underground electronic tags and the detector on the ground. Firstly, this paper introduces the whole system architecture of the underground pipeline detection, studies the changes of the antenna inductance of the underground electronic tags caused by the pressure and corrosion factors of the soil buried in the ground and the changes of the antenna inductance of the detector on the ground caused by the external temperature and humidity. In order to compensate the changes of the antenna inductance of the underground label and the detector and improve the robustness of the system, the conception of a double-channels frequency adjustment system is proposed. The hardware design is introduced, and the logic analysis is carried out accordingly. Then, the hardware system scheme and PCB layout of the double-channels frequency adjustment module are shown. Finally, the feasibility of the system is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Intelligent Technology Related to Warehousing and Distribution in Intelligent Logistics
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Logistics industry is closely related to people's life, but at present, the efficiency of logistics industry is not high, there is still room for improvement. Information technology has a revolutionary significance for the future development of warehousing logistics. The core of how to complete the efficient operation of various materials in the warehouse lies in how to excavate the value of big data related to the warehouse and combine it with various equipment and operation strategies in the warehouse. This paper mainly discusses the development motivation of intelligent logistics, the related technology in warehousing and distribution, and the future development direction of warehousing and distribution. In the future, a series of new business models and technological advances will usher in new development opportunities for the logistics industry, and the specific application of intelligent logistics will be more and more integrated into people's lives.

articleTitle: Review and Prospect of the Research on Leader Regulatory-Focused Behavior
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The regulatory focus theory has been widely discussed and confirmed in academic circles. However, the study on how to regulate employee's organizational behavior from the perspective of leadership style to improve organizational performance still lacks of focus, and the systematic analysis and cognition is urgently needed. Through reviewing and summarizing the existing literature, the concept connotation, structural dimension, influencing factors and effect results of leader regulatory-focused behavior are reviewed in this paper. The shortcomings of the existing research are also summarized for the prospects for future theoretical research.

articleTitle: Grid Enterprise Equipment Quality Management Situation Analysis and Problem Diagnosis Research
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: As the company's core assets, equipment's stable and reliable quality is an important prerequisite for the company's development and grid security. Under the new situation and new requirements, equipment quality management must strengthen the foundation, innovate and break through, solve some long-standing old problems, and respond the new challenges brought by the current challenges fully support the implementation of the company's development strategy. This article focuses on the improvement of equipment quality management, systematically studies the current internal and external situations facing quality management, summarizes the related effectiveness of past management and points out the problems.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation Model of Human Resource Management in Public Institutions Based on Improved Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In order to better evaluate and manage the human resource performance of public institutions, the performance evaluation model of human resource management is constructed by combining decision tree method. According to the dimension principle of human resource management, this paper optimizes the human resource performance management system and performance evaluation system of public institutions, and constructs the performance evaluation model of human resource management of public institutions based on the principle of decision tree. On this basis, the organizational form and functional indicators of performance evaluation are designed to achieve the comprehensive evaluation of human resource management performance. The experimental results show that the model has higher practical value and performance evaluation satisfaction, and fully meets the research requirements.

articleTitle: Life Cycle Cost Assessment of Condition Monitoring Sensors in Smart Distribution Room
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Based on the theory of life cycle analysis and the operation and maintenance statistics of Guangzhou Power Supply Bureau, the life cycle cost analysis model for intelligent power distribution room sensors is proposed and revised, and the relevant sensitivity calculation is given. The cost and cost sensitivity of each stage of the sensor are analyzed in detail, and the proportion of the life cycle costs of the six sensors is compared horizontally. The results show that the operation cost is the dominant factor in the life cycle cost of six kinds of sensors, accounting for 54.62-76.90%; high procurement costs bring about quality improvement, which can greatly reduce operating and failure costs. It provides a reference for the selection of smart power distribution room sensors from the perspective of life cycle cost.

articleTitle: The Effect of Squat on College Students' Tennis Service in big Data Era
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Objective: To explore the effect of squat on serving effect of College Students' tennis. Method: 16 male college students were randomly divided into two groups for 8 weeks of normal training. Serve test after 8 weeks. Results: The service speed of the experimental group was significantly faster than that of the control group, with a very significant difference (p<0.01); The service success rate of the experimental group was higher than that of the control group, with a significant difference (p<0.05); There was no significant difference in service stability between the experimental group and the control group. Conclusion: For college students, it is helpful to increase squat in tennis training: 1) Serve speed. 2) It helps to improve the service success rate. 3) There is no evidence to improve service stability.

articleTitle: Study and Application of Multi-valve Micro-Control Technology in Steam Turbine Excitation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: China's power plant steam turbines often encounter steam turbine excitation problems in the use of steam turbines. The linkage micro-control multi-valve regulation technology studied in the paper is to use the turbine operating parameters as a reference. The internal steam excitation problem that occurs in the high-speed operation of the steam turbine, which is caused by the eccentricity of the rotor after the fault analysis; the impeller gap at each stage is unevenly distributed in the circumferential direction when the rotor has a certain eccentricity, which result in uneven distribution of steam entering the flow path in the circumferential direction; thereby it generate the same tangential force as the rotor linear velocity direction and the internal steam flow excitation of the blade. The corresponding parameter range is obtained by the micro-control change of single project parameters, the deviation of the set value and the correction parameters are determined. After the verification and practice of the valve control logic, the multi-valve adjustment linkage based on micro-control is proposed. The micro-control debugging is used to correct the influence of the eccentricity of the turbine bearing blades by optimizing the valve position command and feedback correction. Through testing and verifying the linkage micro-control multi-valve regulation technology, the function and effect of the solution are proved, which guarantees the normal operation of the steam turbine.

articleTitle: Impact of Classroom Facilities on Evacuation and Its Simulation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The problem of emergency evacuation has been widely concerned by academic circles, especially indoor emergency evacuation. In this paper, Netlogo simulation tool is used to establish a multi-agent simulation model of classroom evacuation, study the problem of classroom emergency evacuation, and analyze the impact of factors such as layout of classroom facilities on evacuation efficiency. First, the simulation model is established and the model is verified. Then, the classroom evacuation process was simulated to analyze the impact of the number of staff, exit width, exit number and classroom layout on evacuation. The results show that with the increase of the number of people, evacuation becomes more and more difficult. At this time, double exits allowing two people to walk together, increasing the number of channels and optimizing the layout of tables and chairs can greatly improve evacuation efficiency. Finally, the corresponding improvement is proposed to improve the efficiency of classroom evacuation.

articleTitle: DO Trade Openness Cause to Accelerate Foreign Direct Investment Inflows? A Case of 10 Developing Nations
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: This paper analyzes the impact of trade openness on FDI inflows in 10 Developing countries ( Bangladesh, China, India, Indonesia, Iran, Egypt, Nigeria, Malaysia, Pakistan and Turkey). Panel data for the period of 1997-2018 has been used and analyzed through random effect technique, the results shows that trade openness has positive and significant impact on FDI inflows. Market size, economic development and infrastructure also exert positive and significant influence on FDI inflows, while exchange rate has negative but significant effect on FDI inflows.

articleTitle: Research on Commodity Trade Relationship Between China and Russia Under the Background of the Belt and Road Initiative
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the approach of the Belt and Road Initiative, China-Russia economic and trade cooperation is improving into high-level and high-dimension direction. This paper firstly analyzes the scale and structure of China-Russia trade. Then based on the trade complementarity index and competitive advantage index, this paper analyzes the trade complementarity and competitiveness between China and Russia. In conclusion we find that China and Russia cooperate closely in trade, but with a simple trade structure and low-tech trade products. In addition, the two countries show a high level of complementarity, but a low level of competitiveness, which implies that the two countries do not conflict in advantageous products. For China, it takes competitive advantages in labor-intensive products, and Russia takes competitive advantages in primary products. In terms of the Belt and Road Initiative, it is necessary for China and Russia to optimize the bilateral trade structure and further promote the bilateral economic and trade cooperation.

articleTitle: Research on Listing Approaches and Implementation Methods of Project Expenditure Under the Reform of Transmission and Distribution Tariff
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In order to realize Quality Improving and Efficiency Enhancing of the company, and further improve the management efficiency and effectiveness of power transmission and transformation project construction, this article will analyze the distribution impact that the grid enterprise business model transformation brings to the other expense of power transmission and transformation project construction after the transmission and distribution price reform, at the meanwhile, this article will study the impact on the company's permitted income verification whether the cost occurred in the late stage of engineering is included in the engineering cost or production cost, and finally propose specific implementation methods and risk management and control suggestions of post-engineering costs, which can effectively standardize the application of other expense, and further improve the project construction and management level, so that the Power grid projects can be carried out in order.

articleTitle: Research on Nondestructive Testing Signal of Beam-Slab Wharf Pile Foundation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Piles foundation of beam-slab wharf is deeply buried in soil and the top of pile is constrained by the superstructure. The detection of pile foundation of beam slab wharf is concealed and complex. First, the finite element model of pile foundation of beam-slab wharf is established, and LS-DYNA is used to simulate the actual nondestructive testing of pile foundation of wharf. Then, deconvolution is used to filter the interference signal in the original signal. Based on the post-processing signal, the integrity of the reinforced pile cap wharf pile can be obtained effectively. According to the above methods, different excitation methods and signal processing methods are used to analyze the pile foundation of beam slab wharf with constraint pile cap, which provides theoretical guidance for practical engineering.

articleTitle: Research on the Cultivation of Autonomous Learning Ability Based on SPOC Differentiated Teaching Mode: Take "Engineering Contract Management" as an Example
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the development of Internet and the popularization of online courses, the SPOC (Small Private Online Course) mixed teaching model can be promoted in colleges and universities. This model reform will bring different results due to differences in students' independent learning ability. Therefore, based on the investigation and analysis of students' online learning, this paper puts forward that differential training should be carried out. Taking the "Engineering Contract Management" course as an example, this course designs the multi-level objective requirements and multi-level teaching path of differentiated training, effectively integrates online and offline education, and strengthens the cultivation of independent learning ability of different basic students.

articleTitle: Study on the Problems of the Informatization Process of Engineering Cost Management in China
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the continuous development of information network technology, the traditional engineering cost management mode has not adapted to the needs of the development of the times. In addition, engineering cost management reform is imperative. It is an important direction for the development of engineering cost management to use information network technology in engineering cost management activities to promote the informatization construction of engineering cost management. The problems existing in the process of construction cost management informatization in China are systematically summarized through literature reading. Based on this, the key problems are screened out using the analytic hierarchy process. The study concluded that there are nine key problems in the process of the construction of engineering cost management in China: human capacity, management regulations, management mechanisms, ideological understanding, information system construction, information sharing, information quality, information update, and information collection. We hope that this study has certain reference significance for promoting the development of China's engineering cost management informatization construction.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Factor Market Distortion on the Complexity of Export Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Based on current distortion of China's factor market, this paper starts from international technology spillover and probes into the impact of factor market distortion on the complexity of export technology. Based on an empirical analysis, the authors figure out that the distortion of factor market will hinder the improvement of export technology complexity. In addition, the distortion of factor market is conducive to work on China's export spillover effect and import spillover effect, but the factor market distortions are not conducive to work on FDI spillover effects and patent spillover effects. In conclusion, we can promote the complexity of manufacturing export technology but inhibit the increase in the complexity of export technology.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Compliance between Cape Town Agreement and China's Technical Rules for Statutory Inspection of Ocean Going Fishing Vessels
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Through the comparative analysis of the technical provisions of Cape Town agreement and the technical provisions of China's "technical rules for statutory inspection of ocean going fishing vessels", this paper finds out the main gaps, revises the lagging and obsolete technical provisions, and lays the foundation for accession to the convention from the legal system, striving for a favorable position in the performance of the Convention.

Author Keywords: technical rules for statutory inspection of pelagic fishing vessels

articleTitle: Compensation Contract for Managers of Passive Funds
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: It is generally considered that compensation contract will change the level of managers' efforts, thus significantly affecting the return and risk of securities investment funds.By constructing a game model combining behavioral finance and classical principal-agent theory, we analyzed the structure of compensation contract for managers of passive funds. It is found that for passive funds, the optimal investment strategy of fund managers is to abandon any initiative efforts and adopt a passive follow-through investment strategy.

articleTitle: Assessing Sustainability of Industrial Ecosystem in Shaanxi of China
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Assessing sustainability of industrial ecosystem (SIE) is important reference for the sound sustainable development of industrial ecosystem. Based on the principle of the triple bottom line, combined with the actual situation of Shaanxi, this paper constructed a comprehensive evaluation system for SIE with the subsystems of economy, society and environment. The composite index of SIE was based on the data from 2008 to 2018, using method of entropy to allocate the weights. The assessment results indicate that the grade of Shaanxi SIE evolved to high level year by year, showing a steady trend of improvement. It can be interpreted that combined effect of the adjustment and optimization of industrial structure and emission reduction are significant, and there is room for further improvement of SIE. The policy guidance plays a significant role in the sustainable development of industrial ecosystem.

articleTitle: Research on Balance Improvement of Mobile Phone Production Line of A Company Based on IE Method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Based on the production line balance principle and work measurement, this paper calculates the production line balance rate, production line balance loss, smoothness index and other production line balance indexes of A company's mobile phone production line. And the industrial engineering method is used to analyze and improve the production line of A company's mobile phone. After the improvement, the production line balance rate increases from 71.86% to 89.86%, and the smoothness index decreases from 1.7 to 0.59, the improvement effect is significant.

articleTitle: Research on the Decomposition of the Post-Cruise Operation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The post-operation of the ship is a more complicated operation stage, which is different from the maturity of the pre-operation. The post-operation is still in a relatively ignorant stage, and the post-operation of the cruise ship is more disordered due to its own comprehensiveness Through the analysis of the characteristics of cruise operations, the entry point of the decomposition of cruise operations is explored.

articleTitle: Notice of Removal: Implementation of the Magnet Program Based on the Triple Helix Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Removed.

articleTitle: Research on the Development Problems and Management Countermeasures of Third-Party Logistics in China
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the rise of network economy, third-party logistics has attracted extensive attention. China's third-party logistics industry started late and developed at a low level. The number of large professional third-party logistics enterprises is small, and their market share in the whole logistics industry is also low, which restricts the development of national economy to a certain extent. These problems mainly come from the market, government, law, information, logistics enterprises themselves and other aspects. Aiming at the above problems, this paper puts forward a series of management countermeasures to promote the sustainable development of the third-party logistics industry in China.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Schema Inconsistency Information in Brand Association on Consumers' Participation Intention -- A Two-Mediation Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The relationship between the degree of consistency and inconsistency in brand association and consumer's decision-making behavior is an important issue in today's cross-border brand association. Based on the theory of schema inconsistency, this paper constructs a path mechanism research model based on the degree of brand association schema inconsistency as independent variables, perceived utility value and perceived hedonic value as double mediating variables, and consumers' participation intention including sharing intention and purchase intention as dependent variables. The combined products were selected by two pre-experiments and the relationship was investigated in the formal inter-group experiment. Study found: schema inconsistency in brand association has a significant impact on consumers' participation intention, and perceived hedonic value plays an intermediary role in the relationship between schema inconsistency in brand association and consumers' participation intention, and it is an inverted U-shaped relationship. Perceived hedonic value has a greater impact on sharing intention than perceived utility value, while perceived utility value has a greater impact on purchase intention than perceived hedonic value.

articleTitle: To buy or not to buy? Analysis of Consumers' Purchase Intention in the Context of Multiple Shopping Festival
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Online shopping is an indispensable part of current consumer life, and the holding of online shopping festivals also has a profound impact on consumers' purchasing behavior. Through literature review, this paper explores the influencing factors of consumers' purchase intention under multiple shopping festivals. This paper believes that the factors that influence consumers' willingness to buy at multiple shopping festivals mainly include four factors: the scale of shopping festivals, the degree of false discounts of online retailers, the experience of consumer shopping festivals and price expectations. Among them, consumers' purchase sentiment is influenced by consumers' emotions.

articleTitle: Construction and Practice of Independent Open and Innovative Laboratory Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Extracurricular activities of science and technology are an effective way to strengthen college students' practical ability and innovative spirit. The University Students' independent and open innovation laboratory is the realization platform of this way. Through extracurricular science and technology activities, colleges and universities can strengthen the quality training of College students, including hands-on ability, team spirit, employment competitiveness and innovation ability. However, with the increasing number of students participating, extracurricular science and technology activities are also restricted by venues, equipment, funds and management, which restrict the smooth development of this activity. Firstly, this paper analyses the advantages of independent open innovation laboratory for college students' training. Then, this paper analyses the construction mode of the laboratory. Finally, this paper lists some practical measures.

articleTitle: Research on Desiccant Humidity Recognition and Automatic Dehumidifier of Transformer Oil Pillow Respirator
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The internal desiccant of the transformer oil pillow respirator can reduce the oily moisture of the transformer insulation and improve the oily insulation performance of the transformer. However, due to the influence of moisture, the internal desiccant of the respirator requires manual replacement of the desiccant. The replacement of desiccant is not only time-consuming, but also has the risk of direct contact between oil and air of transformer, Therefore, this paper proposes to use image recognition technology to develop a transformer oil pillow respirator desiccant humidity recognition and automatic dehumidification device. The device performs image recognition and processing on the color of the discolored desiccant inside the respirator, and calculates the humidity of the desiccant inside the respirator according to the relationship between the desiccant humidity and the color. When the humidity reaches a critical value, the heater and fan are automatically started to dry. The automatic dehumidification of the agent reduces the humidity of the desiccant, realizes the recycling of the desiccant, and improves the insulation performance of the transformer. The humidity identification of the desiccant of the oil respirator of the transformer and the automatic dehumidification device are of great significance to ensure the safety of power supply.

articleTitle: Research on Balance Application of Pastry Production Line Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Food production line balance is a key factor affecting food production cost, delivery time and service level. In order to reduce costs and improve efficiency, it is necessary to study the balance of food production line. This paper takes pastry production as the research object, analyzes the production status and production line balance, builds a production line balance optimization model, designs a genetic algorithm, and uses MATLAB programming to solve. Finally, before and after comparison of the production line balance, the improved production line beat is reduced by 28.2%, the production line balance rate is increased by 39.1%, the smoothing coefficient is reduced by 75.7%, the output is increased by 22.8%/day, and the total cost is saved by 205545.6 yuan/year. The results show that a reasonable production line balance design has an important positive effect on the company's cost, delivery time and other indicators.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influencing Factors of Enterprise Management on Employee Loyalty in Gig Economy
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology and the emergence of burgeoning technologies, various business models have developed rapidly, and gig economy model has appeared in people's daily life. The gig economy has changed the traditional employment model where practitioners and platform enterprises often cooperate on the basis of trust, thus the loyalty of "casual laborer" has become an important issue for the development of enterprises. Through literature review, this paper explores the influencing factors of enterprise management on employee loyalty in gig economy. This paper believes that the influencing factors of enterprise management on employee loyalty in gig economy mainly include the following three: enterprise incentive mechanism, enterprise management communication, and enterprise culture. Among them, the incentive mechanism contains performance appraisal management and career management.

articleTitle: Catastrophic Psychology Under Novel Coronavirus Pneumonia: From the Perspective of Social Governance
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Psychological trauma suffered by the group when disaster happened, and it has the following characteristics: Persistence, repeatability and susceptibility. This paper is explore the method of cohesion of community governance function, coupling of social organization and governance, establishment of "cloud" international public security system. and hoped that through the perspective of social governance to discuss the establishment of social health management system, health media communication and transmission path, community psychological guidance. To achieve the goal that social governance capacity will be improved, social protection network will be well organized, unexpected disasters will be dealt with, so as to ensure the stability of the govern comprehensively and the normal operation of social order.

articleTitle: Evaluating Public-Private-Partnership Policy System in China Based on a Two-Layer Multi-Level Framework
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Public-private-partnership (PPP) mode is widely applied in China, forming a win-win mechanism of cooperation between government and social capital in infrastructures, public projects and services. However, the execution of PPP projects needs to be further standardized by improving the policy system of PPP and strengthening the implementation of policies and regulations. In order to evaluate and optimize the current PPP policy system, this study conducted text analysis of 458 policy documents on the basis of a two-layer and multi-level coding framework. Results show that there are structural and functional constraints in the PPP policy system in China. Finally, this paper proposed a series of suggestions for policy system to be optimized during different life-cycle stages of PPP projects. This original research provides a paradigm for systematically analyzing the policy system in PPP projects.

articleTitle: Research on the Dynamic Mechanism of Major Project Innovation Led by the Owner
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The owner-led major project innovation management model has been proved by practice to be a very suitable organization management model for major innovation projects. As the leading party in the entire process of engineering innovation and project implementation, the owner is of great significance to how to effectively stimulate the willingness of the participating entities to cooperate in innovation and promote multi-party collaborative innovation. In this research, we conduct research on the major engineering innovation dynamic mechanism led by the owner and collaborative innovation of production, education and research, build a dynamic mechanism framework, analyze relevant factors and their role relationships, and give suggestions on the dynamic mechanism based on the analysis results.

articleTitle: Establishment of International After-Sales Service System for Coal Mine Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In view of the wide variety of special equipment in coal mines, the complexity of equipment, the small number of equipment sets, and the wide international market, the long distance, the different policies of various countries, leading to low service efficiency, different service quality, and high service costs. Taking the regionalization, localization and individualization as the idea, it adopts a point-multifaceted management organization form, combined with the actual situation of different markets, to form an overall management and control, and a regional independent after-sales service system. It solves the contradiction between the Space and time, quality and cost of equipment after-sales service in the process of internationalization, and achieves the goal of high efficiency, high quality and low cost indicators of after-sales service. It is the key for enterprises to go global, stand firm in the market, and achieve steady profitability by establishment of an international wide-area after-sales service system for coal mine special equipment.

articleTitle: Temperature Field Analysis of Hub Motor Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In order to accurately simulate the influence of temperature change on the performance of permanent magnet hub motor, the finite element method is used to simulate the electromagnetic field and the thermal network method is used to simulate the temperature field, which provides a reference for the optimal design and efficient application of the hub motor. Besides, this paper lays a foundation for studying the temperature rise and temperature field distribution of hub motor under complex operating conditions. At the same time, it provides a theoretical basis for further improving the power density and torque density of hub motor.

articleTitle: Trade Facilitation and Pakistan's Import: A Gravity Model Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: International trade is an integral part of development and growth of an economy. Increasing bilateral trade, providing right institutional structures and policies, reduction in tariffs and improvements in the infrastructure results in enhancing the economic growth. As a developing country, foreign trade is of great significance to Pakistan's economic development. This paper uses gravity model to examine the relationship between trade facilitation and import flow. The index of trade facilitation is constructed by 12 indicators using Principle Component Analysis. The findings show that improvement in trade facilitation impacts the import flow of Pakistan. If exporting countries provide trade facilitation for Pakistan, then the imports from Pakistan will increase. Whereas, if Pakistan enhances the trade facilitation then the imports decrease. Additionally, GDP of the exporting countries is statistically significant. However, distance between the countries tends to have no impact on the import flow of Pakistan. While the dummy variable border is significant which depicts that sharing a common border with exporting countries impacts the import flow of Pakistan.

articleTitle: Study on Predictive Model of Financial Distress Based on Rotation Forest Ensembles of Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In the era of big data, enterprise financial distress prediction requires the model to have higher and higher data classification accuracy, stronger generalization performance and more effective application to the classification of large sample data. A new model which combines rotation forest with support vector machine was proposed to solve these problems. The proposed model can solve the problem of overfitting in the original rotation forest and improve the classification performance. The experiment results show that proposed model can effectively improve the prediction accuracy of financial distress, which is crucial for the formulation and adjustment of enterprise strategy and the decision of investors.

articleTitle: Quanlitative Orgniazation Management Evaluation: A Case Study of Changzhou Wujin Dazhong Standard Parts Co. Ltd
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: This article analyzes the management and operations of the company Changzhou Wujin Dazhong Standard Parts Co. Ltd (CWDSP), Jiangsu, China. Using qualitative research methods, such as interviews and participative observation, the author evaluates a few key factors of the company's organizational management. The evaluative factors include Organizational Commitment, Job Satisfaction, Stress Level, Leadership Type, Team Qualities, Organizational Culture, and Trust, Justice & Ethics in this article. Based on the evaluation results, recommendations regarding organization management and operations are provided for improvement and optimization.

articleTitle: Stock Price Crash Risk of Listed Companies with A Senior Executive Concurrently Serving as Board Secretary
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: As the board secretary is vital to information disclosure of a listed company, will the quality of information disclosure be reduced if a senior executive concurrently serves as board secretary, thus increasing the stock price crash risk? In this study, internal relation between the senior executive concurrently serving as board secretary and stock price crash risk is investigated with A-share listed companies as examples. This study finds that stock price crash risk of listed companies will be increased if a senior executive concurrently serves as board secretary. Study conclusions show that the information disclosure quality of listed companies will impair and their stock price crash risk will increase when a senior executive concurrently serves as board secretary. Therefore, the supervision of listed companies whose senior executives serve as part-time board secretaries should be enhanced to reduce the crash risk of their stock prices.

articleTitle: Safety Risks, Prevention and Control of Dangerous Chemicals Tank Farms in Ports
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Based on the identification and analysis of typical accident cases of dangerous chemicals tank farms in ports, this paper puts forward safety prevention and control measures in line with the characteristics of dangerous chemicals tank farms in ports from the perspective of intrinsic safety, which provides a theoretical basis and decision support for improving the safety management and emergency response of dangerous chemicals tank farms in ports and realizing effective safety risk control of dangerous chemicals tank farms in ports.

Author Keywords: dangerous chemicals tank farms in ports

articleTitle: Research on Quota Method of Spacecraft Quotation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Based on the engineering quota method and the actual situation of aerospace enterprise, the quota method of spacecraft is studied. The framework and principles of spacecraft quota is established, and the quota method of is explored for the follow-up spacecraft quotation.

articleTitle: Management Mechanism Innovation of Owner-led Large-Scale Demonstration Projects Project
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Large-scale demonstration projects are of great significance to promote technological progress and economic development. Focusing on the typical characteristics of large-scale demonstration projects, this paper studies the construction of owner-led organization management model, proposes the owner-led organization management method based on system engineering, and clarifies the main operational mechanism, thus providing guidance and reference for organization management practice of large-scale demonstration project.

articleTitle: The Impact of new Epidemic Situation on Short-Term Choice and Long-Term Upgrading of Consumer Behavior
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: This paper first analyzes the relevant theories of consumer behavior and consumer public consumption under the current situation. Then it provides the new opportunities and choices faced by traditional consumer industries, such as the change of consumer behavior in traditional offline business models such as education consumption, retail consumption, catering consumption and financial consumption. Finally discussing the long-term new consumption rise caused by the change of consumer orientation. This study will help enterprises in related industries to avoid industry reshuffle, lay out in advance, grasp new opportunities, and make policy recommendations for the government to support the development of related enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Calibration Technology of Transformation Ratio Tester
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the gradual improvement of the transformation ratio test method and related technologies, the accuracy of the transformation ratio tester has been correspondingly improved, and the requirements for its verification methods are also increasing. Aiming at the problems in the verification of the variable ratio tester, the test principle of the variable ratio tester is analyzed, and an automatic calibration technique is used to realize the automatic calibration of the variable ratio tester. The calculation of the uncertainty is to ensure the accuracy of the test results of the variable ratio tester, but in order to further ensure the accuracy of the test results, it is necessary to conduct a systematic test on the system to verify the accuracy and stability of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Remote Monitoring Method of Body State and Physiological Parameters During Fitness
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Real-time physiological parameter monitoring equipment has become an urgent need, and the integration of physiological parameter detection technology and intelligent body monitoring technology can not only meet the social needs of family-oriented medical monitoring equipment, but also corresponds to the medical "4P" concept of medicine, which enables users to enjoy personalized, networked real-time health monitor. Therefore, based on the monitoring of the physical parameters of the body state machine in the fitness process of the remote monitoring system in the wireless mode, an intelligent monitoring system is designed in the paper, which can not only feed back the collected data of various physiological parameters of the human body to the smart device through wireless mode, but also provides data services for the family monitoring terminal of the community medical system. Experimental testing proves that the system has good data collection effect, so that the effect of medical index collection on family health population service can be achieved.

articleTitle: A Balanced Analysis of the Management of Higher Education Budgetary Funds
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Based on the provincial panel data from 2005 to 2017, the paper investigates the input level of higher education budget funds in various regions of our country, and uses the index of mean, standard deviation to describe the regional differences of the average student general public budget education expenditure in east, middle and west regions. The research shows that, although the imbalance of budget expenditure on higher education in China is reduced, there is still imbalance between regions, and there is some imbalance within the region.
