Furthermore, the paper also examines the impact of per capita GDP, per capita financial income, the ratio of education expenditure to public budget expenditure, and the consumption price index of residents in the region on the expenditure standard of education budget per student.

articleTitle: How Chinese Enterprises Realize Socially Responsible Human Resource Management – from the Perspective of Stakeholders
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In these years, Chinese enterprises have been increasing at an exponential rate, with employees surging accordingly. How to realize effective human resource management to improve the enterprises' efficiency has become a key issue for enterprise managers. With the idea of socially responsible human resource management gaining popularity in China, how to realize socially responsible human resource management and maximize the stakeholders' benefits become an urgent problem that enterprises need to address. This study explores how to realize socially responsible human resource management from the perspective of stakeholders and proposes corresponding measures and suggestions.

articleTitle: Impact of Personal Income Tax Reform on Income Redistribution from Residents' Subjective Perception
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Most literatures in the past focused on whether personal income tax reform in 2011 had played a significant positive role in income redistribution. However, in this paper, we like to exam whether Chinese people recognize the impact of current personal income tax reforms on income redistribution. The paper uses the data set of Urban Household of Income and Asset of 2013 from China Household Income Project (CHIP). The result indicated that Personal Income Tax Reform is not efficient to improve income redistribution from residents' subjective perceptions.

articleTitle: Unique Status of Civil Aviation: An Empirical Research on Emergency Air Transportation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Civil aviation, with its incomparable advantages of great maneuverability, strong adaptability and highly efficiency, has played an extremely important role in various emergency rescue actions. Based on the retrospective study of historical rescue supporting cases in China, current paper studies the unique status of civil aviation in emergency response by sorting out the important role that played by civil aviation in previous emergencies. A comparative study on the actual traveling speed of China's high-speed railway figured trains which made great progress in recent years has been made as well. At the same time, the paper analyzes the deficiencies of civil aviation emergency rescue in practice for the aim at providing reference for the follow-up work.

articleTitle: Research on the Optimization of Hazardous Materials Transportation Route Considering the Difference of Emergency Response Capability
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Considering the difference of emergency response capacity in different geographical regions, a multi-objective route optimization model was constructed with the transportation cost, transportation risk and risk equity in consideration of emergency response capacity. The risk of hazardous materials road transportation was innovatively considered from the perspective of risk equity, and the feasibility of the model was verified through an example analysis. The experimental results show that the multi-objective model can effectively take into account the interests of the government, the transporter and the citizen, and the results are of certain reference value to the decision-makers.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence Mechanism of Performance Excellence Model on Enterprise Performance
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Based on the theories of Total Quality Management, Performance Excellence Model, Organizational Learning Theory, Performance Management Theory, Contingency Theory and Enterprise Life Cycle Theory, this paper analyses the relationship between the key elements of Performance Excellence Model (Executive Support, Strategic Plan, Customer Drive, Resource Allocation, and Procedure Management) on enterprise performance, and proposes a conceptual model of influence mechanism with organizational learning (Explorative Learning and Exploitative Learning) as mediating variables, market competitiveness and enterprise life cycle as moderating variables, which provide theoretical support for improving enterprise performance.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influencing Factors of Female Leadership Style on Enterprise Developmen
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: As a group with multiple roles, female leaders have attracted the attention of many scholars in the field of management. Female leaders usually have a unique leadership style, which exerts a certain influence on the development of enterprises. This paper aims to analyze the leadership styles possessed by female leaders and discuss the influencing factors of female leadership style on enterprise development. Through literature review, this paper believes that the influencing factors of female leadership style on the development of enterprises mainly include the following three aspects: paternalistic leadership style, transformational leadership style and democratic leadership style. Among them, paternalistic leadership style is mainly reflected in the initial stage of enterprise establishment, while transformational leadership style and democratic leadership style are mainly performed in the middle and late stage of enterprise development.

articleTitle: Research on the Calculation Method of Transmission Bandwidth Demand of Private Network Communication Hub Station
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Bandwidth demand prediction is not only the basis for the preparation of communication network planning, but also an important prerequisite for optimizing the efficiency of resource allocation and maximizing the efficiency of communications support. This paper explores the problems related to the prediction of transmission bandwidth demand of private network communication hub stations. The author comprehensively analyzes the factors influencing the measurement of transmission bandwidth demand by adopting a service-varying prediction summation method method based on QOS guarantee. By studying the business type models, the author builds a model for calculating the bandwidth demand in access layerof the transmission hub, and selects typical stations in the private network to verify the calculation model. The simulation result shows that when the service quality is ensured, the proposed prediction method can be used to predict the transmission bandwidth in an accurate manner, thereby providing a reference for the optimization of private network planning and resource allocation.

articleTitle: Research and Exploration on Fire Safety Comprehensive Management of Old Campus Based on Management by Objective
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Combined with the characteristics of old buildings, such as aging facilities, dense houses and complex personnel, this paper analyses the common fire safety risk sources in the old campus, and put forward the corresponding fire safety transformation scheme. Based on Management by Objective, the responsibility objectives, evaluation system and fire safety publicity and education mechanism of the old campus fire safety management are established. According to the goal management, different departments and individuals, such as school level safety management department, old campus management office, fire safety technical personnel, are integrated into an organic whole, forming a complete goal chain and goal system. The responsibility and power distribution management of each department has been made clear, the responsibility for the implementation of objectives has been enhanced, and the initiative, enthusiasm and consciousness of departments and employees have been mobilized. Each department and individual can complete the corresponding objectives according to the tasks assigned to them, achieve self-control and self-supervision in the work, so as to achieve the overall performance of the fire safety management objectives.

articleTitle: Research on Improving Equipment Quality Management of Power Grid Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In 2019, the company put forward the development strategy of building a "three-type, two-network" world-class energy internet enterprise. The next three years will be a key breakthrough period for the company's development. As the company's core assets, equipment's stable and reliable quality is an important prerequisite for the company's development and grid security. This paper studies the equipment quality management mode and system optimization of power grid enterprises, on this basis, puts forward the optimization ideas of the company equipment quality management mode, establishes the equipment quality management system framework, and in order to ensure the effective implementation of equipment quality management, summarizes and proposes to optimize and improve the company Key measures of quality management.

articleTitle: Research on the Logical Relationship Between Multi-Level Resources in the Operation Mode of Electric Power Communication
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The stable operation of the power communication system is related to the safe and efficient work of the power system. This paper analyzes the logical relationship of multi-level resources in the operation mode of the power system, formulates suitable business models for different power communication services, proposes the construction of a safe and stable network system for power communication, and studies the logical relationship of multi-level resources in the operation mode of power communication. It can provide a powerful guarantee for the management and production of power enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Factors Influencing Construction Quality of Sleeve Grouting
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: How to supervise the quality of sleeve grouting in construction has become a common concern in the engineering field, so it is very important to study the influencing factors of the quality of sleeve grouting construction process and take corresponding control measures. This paper first analyzes the existing common quality problems of sleeve grouting construction in assembly building, and studies the literature related to the influencing factors of sleeve grouting quality in recent ten years. Based on the field survey, questionnaire survey, expert interview and standard research, an index system of influencing factors of sleeve grouting construction quality in assembly building is constructed.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Classroom Teaching Feedback Based on Mobile Information Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The information management system based on mobile communication platform is based on the integrated communication platform composed of modern mobile communication technology and mobile Internet technology. It realizes the service through the interactive communication of information on multiple platforms such as handheld terminals, servers and personal computers. Mobile, information, electronic and networked, provides the society with a process of efficient, high-quality, standardized, timely, electronic and interactive management and service. With the support of mobile information systems, the current mainstream management information system applications (such as information software systems, office systems, ERP systems, CRM software and logistics management software) can be transplanted to mobile terminals, including education and teaching.

articleTitle: Innovative Practice of Optical Cable Monitoring Technology in the Operation and Maintenance of Optical Cables and Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In order to ensure the stable operation of optical cables and transmission lines and improve their operating quality, optical cable monitoring technology has begun to get more and more widely used in today's optical cable and transmission line operation and maintenance. The application of optical cable monitoring technology to the operation and maintenance monitoring of optical cables and transmission lines can not only find the operation problems of optical cables and transmission lines in time, but also locate the fault points in time to seize the opportunity for maintenance personnel, so that the operation problems of optical cables and transmission lines will be resolved in a timely and effective manner to fully meet the needs of users and promote economic development. Based on this, this paper studies the application and innovation of fiber optical cable monitoring technology in the operation and maintenance of fiber optical cables and transmission lines, in order to provide a reference for the rational application of fiber optical cable monitoring technologies and ensure the safe and stable operation of fiber optical cables and transmission lines.

articleTitle: Innovative Application of Information Management of Prefabricated Construction Components Based on BIM
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: as modern production becomes more scientific, digitalized and intelligent, it becomes necessary to develop an innovative corporate management mode. In traditional construction techniques include on-site pouring of concrete, and the massive amount of powder produced during construction will pollute the air, which goes against the national policy for environmental protection. To solve this problem, it is necessary to develop prefabricated construction to protect the environment, cut the cost of construction and labor. However, the construction components are manifold, and how to better manage these construction components remains a topic worth researching. This study explored the combination of RFID (Radio Frequency Identification), NFC (Near Field Communication) and BIM (Building Information Modeling) technologies in management of construction components, and interpreted how to apply RFID and NFC to prefabricated construction.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Product Evaluation and Sales Characteristic Model Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Since a lot of online evaluation information is accumulated with the application and development of e-commerce industry, sentiment analysis technology can be used to mine and utilize it effectively, so as to provide reference for e-commerce industry management. First, a sentiment semantic classification dictionary was constructed based on the frame semantics theory. Then, based on the dictionary and some rules, the sentiment of online reviews was analyzed. Finally, through the test of online review data, a higher accuracy rate and recall rate were obtained, which proved the validity and effectiveness of the research method.

articleTitle: Research on the Mechanism of Continue Intention of Social E-Commerce Users Based on Information Characteristics of Attachment Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: This article captures the recommended information features from the perspective of static information and dynamic information generation, and expands the application of attachment theory to social e-commerce scenarios. From the perspective of relationships, it explains consumers' emotional attachment to social e-commerce and their willingness to continue using it. Motivation, constructed and tested the theoretical model of information characteristics on emotional attachment and continued willingness to use, systematically explored the causes and consequences of emotional attachment.

articleTitle: Research on Innovation of Agricultural Big Data Information Transmission
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: This paper analyzes the transmission of agricultural big data information, which is helpful to enhance the synergy and operational efficiency of agricultural technology innovation and achievement transformation. Starting from the practical problems faced in the transmission of agricultural information, we discuss the historical opportunities in the effective transmission of agricultural big data information, analyze the linkage mechanism and path selection of agricultural big data information transmission, and propose policy suggestions for improving the linkage mechanism of agricultural information transmission.

articleTitle: Design of Vertical Bicycle Parking Device
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of chaotic parking of bicycles in colleges and universities, which is easy to cause traffic jams, a bicycle parking device suitable for colleges and universities is designed. The whole structure of bicycle parking device is designed and modeled by using SolidWorks software. Through theoretical calculation and static stress analysis, we can know that the structural strength of the device designed in this paper can meet the strength requirements of practical use. The bicycle parking device designed in this paper plays a good guiding role in solving the problem of campus congestion caused by random parking of bicycles and centralized parking of bicycles occupying pedestrian passageways.

articleTitle: Research on Typical Practices of Advanced Equipment Quality Management Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology and the advent of the quality era, the scale of enterprises is becoming larger, modern, and intelligent, and the structure and technology of equipment are more complicated. For the requirements of management, we need to integrate the quality concept of the equipment management process, and gradually develop it into the modern equipment quality management. This paper studies the typical practices of equipment quality management in advanced enterprises, with a view to providing reference experience for the optimization of equipment quality management model.

articleTitle: Relationship Between Psychological Capital and Employability of Poor College Students
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Based on the questionnaire of positive psychological capital (PPQ) and the self-test form of College Students' employability, we distributed 1000 questionnaires from some universities in Guangdong Province, and collected 264 poor college students. The results show that: (1) the psychological capital and employment ability of poor college students are in the middle level, but they are significantly lower than those of non poor college students; there are significant differences in gender, grade, source of students, whether they are the only child or not, poverty degree and other variables respectively; (2) the overall positive psychological capital of poor college students and the level of each factor can predict their employment Ability level. (3) Colleges and poor students can develop their psychological capital through some measures to enhance their employability.

articleTitle: The Construction of Safe Electricity use Paradigm in Poverty-Stricken Areas
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In the process of promoting "two substitutes", restricted by many factors such as national concept, unique environment, economy, technology, etc., the hidden danger of electricity safety in deep poverty Tibetan areas is prominent, and there is a big gap from "having electricity" to "using electricity well". Based on the value standpoint of deep intervention, the perspective of taking root in the local area, and the technical route of multiple integration, this paper explores and constructs a scientific power use paradigm applicable to ethnic poor areas in many dimensions, such as cognitive upgrading, technical guidance, system improvement, and communication diversity, so as to root the targeted poverty alleviation work, help the poor people to get out of poverty and prevent the return to poverty, and promote the construction of beautiful villages.

articleTitle: Research on Static Metering and Accuracy of DC Energy Detection System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of uncertain measurement characteristics of the measurement performance of the DC electric energy detection system, the lack of relevant indicators in the DC measurement and detection system leads to the inaccuracy of the measurement source and measurement value transmission of the detection system. Through the research on the DC energy static measurement detection system, detecting its basic error, combined with the DC energy comparison traceability technology, the traceability comparison of the 0.01-level DC energy measurement standard is completed, so as to realize the comparison of the DC energy standard system. The measurement dynamic comparison detection system can provide accuracy guarantee and further improve the DC energy measurement value transmission system.

articleTitle: Application Research of Frequency Domain Dielectric Response Measuring Technology in Damp Evaluation of Oil-Paper Insulated Capacitive Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Moisture is one of the main factors affecting the insulation performance of oil-paper insulated capacitive equipment. Accurately assessing the insulation condition of wet oil-paper capacitive equipment is the focus of preventive testing of electrical equipment. In this paper, the application of frequency domain dielectric spectroscopy based on dielectric response principle in moisture evaluation of oil-paper insulated capacitor bushing is studied. The testing principle of FDS and PDC and the time-frequency domain dielectric response conversion based on extended Debye model are explained. Through setting up test bushing testing platform and testing analysis of 500kV damp bushing, it is confirmed that the low-frequency dielectric loss value of the FDS test curve can be used as an effective criterion for the insulation of the oil-paper bushing insulation. The frequency domain dielectric response technology is used to evaluate the moisture content of the oil-paper capacitor type bushing. The research results are of great significance to ensure the safe operation of the case.

articleTitle: Research on the Comprehensive Capacity Evaluation of Multimodal Transportation in China's Ports Under the Background of Railway Transportation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In recent years, the construction of multimodal transportation system in China with railway transportation as the main mode of transportation has been encouraged and supported by relevant departments. In order to evaluate the comprehensive capacity of multimodal transportation in China's major ports under the background of railway, firstly, the evaluation index system for comprehensive capacity of multimodal transportation based on railway transportation was established from four aspects: collection and distribution environment, intermodal capacity, operational performance and sustainability. Secondly, a combined weighting method combining the AHP and the information entropy method was used to establish a correlation evaluation model to achieve accurate quantification of the evaluation results. Finally, the evaluation index system and model established are used to evaluate the comprehensive capacity of multimodal transportation in major ports of China. The results show that the ranking of port comprehensive capacity is in line with the actual situation, which shows that it is reasonable to use the combined weighting method to evaluate the comprehensive capacity of China's port multimodal transportation under the background of railway, which provides a certain reference for the development of China's port multimodal transport comprehensive capacity.

articleTitle: Research on the Dilemma of Earthquake Public Opinion Governance and Countermeasures of Scientific Guidance
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The correct handling and guidance of the public opinion of the earthquake network in the new situation is related to the social image of the earthquake department and is an important indicator for testing the modernization of social governance capabilities for earthquake prevention and mitigation. On the basis of summarizing and analyzing the experience and lessons of multiple earthquake public opinion cases, this paper systematically summarizes the social governance dilemma faced by the earthquake public opinion, introduces public opinion index for quantitative analysis, puts forward new countermeasures and suggestions to do a good job in seismic network public opinion scientific guidance under the new situation.This is of great significance to further improve the effectiveness of earthquake public opinion guidance and response capabilities.

articleTitle: Impact of oil Price on Futures and Spot Markets of Commodities in Pakistan (A Comparative Study)
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The study finds out the impact of oil price on futures and spot prices of four commodities including crude oil, gold, rice and wheat. Tests of correlation and regression are used. The results are then subject to comparison to find which of the two markets (futures or spot) is less sensitive to oil price. The results indicate that futures market of commodities is less sensitive to the oil price than spot/cash market of commodities in Pakistan. Comparison between two available markets in terms of their sensitivity to a big economic indicator (oil price) produces valuable results for the beneficiaries.

articleTitle: The Influence of Absorptive Capacity and Perception of Technology Characteristics on Satisfaction with Medical Services: Based on Affordance Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Based on the theory of Affordance, this thesis proposes two analytical dimensions of Subjective Affordance (SA) and Behavioral Affordance (BA). The research aims to explore the influence of patients' Absorptive Capacity (AC) and Technology Characteristics Perception (TCP) on their SA and BA of the WeChat client-side app in community hospitals so as to further evaluate the SA and BA influence on patients' satisfaction of medical service (PS). A total of 410 questionnaires were distributed. The effective questionnaire data (N=387) were checked for descriptive analysis and a path model with 5 observed variables (AC, TCP, SA, BA, PS) was developed. The results indicate that age, educational background, and TCP (evaluation of the innovation characteristics of technology) play an important role in the final implementation of technology application behavior (BA), and the effective application of technology can indeed improve PS. It was also found that the mediation effect of SA is not valid. AC has no direct or indirect influence on PS.

articleTitle: Research on Feature Selection and Key Technology of Satellite Remote Sensing Patrol in Transmission Channel
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In recent years, with economic development, the coverage of power grids has increased year by year, and the mileage of transmission lines has also increased year by year. In order to avoid damage to the transmission line, which would cause a large area of power outage and cause serious economic losses, this paper uses worldview-3 high-resolution satellite imagery as the data source to carry out a transmission channel inspection study based on the multi-scale segmentation technology coupling feature optimization method. Experimental results show that the proposed transmission channel inspection method is feasible, and the overall patrol accuracy can reach more than 86%. Secondly, the order of features patrol will have an important impact on the accuracy of the experimental results. And through experimental analysis, this paper proposes the sequence of water body-vegetation-highway-building-power transmission tower-landslide-construction area-bare land, which can effectively and accurately realize the environmental inspection of transmission channels, and the accuracy of the inspection results is improved by 7.8% compared with other inspection sequences. Thirdly, compared with traditional manual interpretation and supervised classification methods, the method proposed in this paper has higher efficiency and applicability.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Psychological Capital on the Management of Research Projects of University Teachers
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Innovation performance is an important measure of project management. How to strengthen the management of research projects and improve the performance of research projects under the condition of limited resources has become an urgent problem to be solved in Colleges and universities. Through the analysis of the influence of psychological capital of teachers on the performance of innovation of research projects, it is found that, as an important regulator to stabilize emotion and behavior, psychological capital can effectively regulate the influence of external factors on individual behavior and improve the performance of innovation of research projects. Based on this, this paper puts forward strategies to improve the performance of innovation of research projects.

articleTitle: Study on the Status and Optimization Research of Commercial Formats with Medium Size and Above in Northeast China (Take Harbin as an Example)
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the external environment and epidemic situation of the commerce in Harbin, Northeast, China and the research results of the existing commercial formats and the related factors within the commercial formats, and combined with the development of domestic and foreign industries and local characteristics, this paper puts forward the key problems and development direction of local commercial formats in the next 5 to10 years, as well as the suggestions for optimizing the proportion of local commercial formats, and evaluates the optimum proportion of local commercial formats. It provides the basic idea and necessary support for the development of regional industries.

articleTitle: Study on Optimization of Stop Schedule Plan for Urban Rail Transit: A Case Study of Shanghai Metro Line 2
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: We took Shanghai Metro Line 2 as an example to analyze the impact of the implementation of fast-and-slow-line operation scheme on the efficiency of Metro operation. First of all, in order to measure the operation efficiency of the train, this paper adopts three indicators: average time, maximum bearing capacity as well as construction cost. Secondly, in order to analyze the time saved when the fast lines does not stop at the station, we divided the train operation process into four stages: acceleration, uniform speed, deceleration and rest. We first carried out an exploratory study. Then we used MATLAB software to simulate the time needed for the fast and slow lines system to complete the whole journey respectively. The result shows that the time for the fast lines could be reduced by 23 min under the same high speed. In determining the stations for the fast lines to stop, we took the minimum average travel time of passengers as the goal, the passenger flow of each platform and the starting station as constraints to build a 0-1 optimization model. Then we calculated the best platforms for fast lines to stop by the violent search algorithm, and adjusted the stop station slightly according to the actual situation of passenger transfer, so as to make the final scheme for fast lines to stop. In addition, we also carried out sensitivity analysis on the operation efficiency. The result showed that the fasts and slow lines system with different speeds had the highest operating efficiency, followed by the fast and slow lines system with the same speed and the slow train system.

Author Keywords: Fast and Slow Line Operation system

articleTitle: Actualization of IT Affordance and Its Application in Research on Medical Service and Management Informatization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The concept of IS affordance has attracted extensive attention in the field of IS in recent years. Research based on this concept will help to understand the differences in user perception and application of IT artifacts. Relevant research shows that the informatization of medical services and management will result in unsatisfactory IT promotion and application because users cannot finally actualize IT affordance. Actualization of IT affordance is closely related to the success of medical services optimized by informationization. With reference to the previous research on medical service informatization based on the actualization of IT affordance lens, the mutually-influencing relationship between the various factors in the actualization of IT affordance is sorted out, thus deriving a brief exploration of the IT affordance actualization mechanism. We attempt to propose a conceptual model to provide a starting point and inspiration for the future empirical research.

articleTitle: Chinese Foreign Direct Investments in the EU: Challenges and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: This study focuses on an analysis of Chinese investments in Europe. Special attention is being given to identifying the challenges that Chinese investors face while investing in the EU. The research describes the main parts of the trade and investment relationships between the EU and China, focuses in-depth on the investment part. An important part of the research aimed at the discussion of Chinese FDI in the EU. It provides information about the investment flows, industries for investments, receiver states, and forms of investments. Special attention in the research is given to the reason why the EU is postponing the signing of the bilateral investment agreement between China and the EU and what is behind it. The main method of research is comparative analysis. Based on the analyzes of the data and publications, the results of the research indicate the five main challenges. Such challenges as political opposition, national security concerns, style of managing a company, difficulties with regulations, and FDI control – create an additional limitation for Chinese companies in the EU. EU companies in China still have many more regulations and restrictions than Chinese companies in the EU.
